title_en: Those who left their homes by the thousands
notes: DRAFT for scholarly review; nothing here is reviewed or published. English only: the Arabic and Urdu texts are left null for translators. Written from the Quran text in content/quran (Tanzil Uthmani) in the drafter's own words; no published translation is quoted. Quran only: no hadith, no tafsir, no later tradition in the story texts. This is an EVENT draft: it is shorter than the prophet drafts, stays inside the event's own inventory refs and states only what those ayat state; the prophet stories (content/stories) are not repeated here. Chapters are a reading order, not a chronology the Quran claims. Honorifics are added when the page is rendered.

claims.statement_en: The ayah asks whether one has not considered those who went out from their homes, in the thousands, fearing death.
God said to them: die; then He gave them life.
God has bounty over people, but most people do not give thanks.

chapters.summary_md: The ayah speaks of people who went out from their homes in the thousands, fearing death [c1]. God said to them: die; then He gave them life [c2].
chapters.body_md: The ayah asks whether one has not considered those who went out from their homes, in the thousands, fearing death [c1]. God said to them: die; then He gave them life [c2]. God has bounty over people, but most people do not give thanks [c3].
chapters.deep_md: The ayah is one sentence and carries a series of statements: the going out, the saying of God and then the giving of life, and the remark on thanks [c1][c2][c3]. It gives no names and no setting, so the account is as short as the verse [c1].
chapters.kids_md: Once some people left their homes, many thousands of them, because they were afraid of dying [c1]. God said to them: die; then He gave them life [c2].
chapters.lessons_md: Educational interpretation (not scripture): One reading is that fear of death is set beside God's power to give life [c1][c2]. Another is that the ayah ends by saying most people do not give thanks for God's bounty [c3].
chapters.unknowns_md:
- Not established: who these people were, where they lived, why they feared death, and when this was.
- Not established: how they died, how they were given life, or what they did afterwards.
- Not established: whether the words die and then He gave them life describe one event or a manner of speaking; the ayah gives no more.
- The ayah does not say how many thousands.

uncertainties_en: Hadith to add later: authenticated narrations, each with a named grader, on who these people were. None is used in this draft.
Later commentators gave different accounts of the people and the place; none is in the ayah and none is used here.
